body:
The diagram below shows how checked luggage is moved from the check-in desk to the aircraft at a large airport.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: How checked luggage travels from the check-in desk to the aircraft
steps: Passenger hands the bag over at the check-in desk
Airline staff weigh the bag and print a baggage tag
The tag is attached and the bag is placed on a conveyor
The bag passes through an automated security scanner
Flagged bags are checked by hand and returned to the conveyor
Bags with unreadable tags are sent to a manual sorting station
Cleared bags are sorted by flight and loaded into containers
Containers are driven across the apron to the aircraft
Ground crew lift the bags into the aircraft hold

body:
The diagram below shows the stages in the manufacture of an aluminium bicycle frame.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: Manufacture of an aluminium bicycle frame
steps: Aluminium tubes are cut to the required lengths
The tube ends are shaped to fit the joints
The tubes are fixed together in a jig
The joints are welded by a robot
The frame is heat-treated to strengthen the metal
The frame is cleaned and checked for cracks
The frame is painted and the brand logo is applied
Finished frames are packed and sent to assembly plants

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: Railway station and surrounding streets, 2015 and 2030 (planned)

features: Single-storey station building on the north side of the tracks
Ticket office next to the main entrance on Station Road
Car park for 40 cars opposite the station building
Bus stop on the east side of Station Road
Taxi rank between the car park and the main entrance
Cycle parking in the north-west corner of the site
Small café beside platform 1
Goods yard along the south edge of the site
Level crossing at the west end of Station Road
Public toilets behind the café
Footbridge across the tracks near platform 2

after.label: 2030 (planned)
features: Two-storey station building on the north side of the tracks
Ticket office relocated to the south side of the main concourse
Car park for 40 cars opposite the station building
Underground passage in place of the level crossing at the west end
Bus interchange with six bays on the east side of Station Road
Taxi rank between the bus interchange and the main entrance
Cycle parking for 200 bicycles in the north-west corner
Café with outdoor seating beside platform 1
Housing on the former goods yard along the south edge
Footbridge across the tracks near platform 2
